name: markbridge

scripts.build: npm run build:localization && node scripts/copy-math-assets.cjs && esbuild src/kernel.js --bundle --format=iife --global-name=MBB --external:@wordpress/latex-to-mathml --outfile=plugin/kernel.js && esbuild src/emoji.js --bundle --format=iife --outfile=plugin/emoji.js && node scripts/build-ui-assets.cjs && node scripts/build-runtime-contract.cjs && php scripts/build-php-converter.php
scripts.build:php: composer install --working-dir=tools/php-scoper --no-dev --no-interaction --no-plugins --no-scripts --prefer-dist --optimize-autoloader && composer install --working-dir=plugin/includes/php-converter --no-dev --no-interaction --no-plugins --no-scripts --prefer-dist --optimize-autoloader && node scripts/scope-php-converter.cjs
scripts.test: node tests/kernel.cjs && node tests/r10-04.cjs && node tests/task-lists.cjs && node tests/footnotes.cjs && node tests/conversion-diagnostics.cjs && node tests/teaching.cjs && node tests/components.cjs && php tests/component-registry.php && node tests/local-recovery.cjs && php tests/local-recovery.php && node tests/frontmatter.cjs && php tests/frontmatter.php && node tests/resource-import.cjs && php tests/resource-import.php && node tests/code-tabs.cjs && php tests/code-tabs.php && node tests/export.cjs && php tests/export.php && node tests/merge.cjs && php tests/merge.php && node tests/editor-ui-races.cjs && node tests/block-adapters.cjs && php tests/block-adapters.php && node tests/localization.cjs && php tests/localization.php
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run build && python3 scripts/build-localization.py --check && python3 scripts/check_release.py

description: Markdown and WordPress blocks, kept together.
